title: Field Job Workflow
purpose: Analyze one declared generic field-job phase, task, dependency, or evidence handoff using externally supplied workflow facts and descriptive safety context without directing field operations.

non_goals: unrelated well, finance, or regulatory analysis
scope.smallest_sufficient_rule: Analyze only the named P5 concern and return NOT_APPLICABLE when it is absent; do not infer operational, legal, financial, engineering, or model truth.

atomic_scope_statement: One narrow atomic evidence domain: Field Job Workflow; unrelated domain, provider, standard, platform, or failure modes require sibling blocks.
permitted_decisions: analyze the exact named P5 concern
escalate missing authority or conflicting evidence
return NOT_APPLICABLE when the concern is absent
forbidden_decisions: activate, admit, deploy, publish, or self-accept
broaden to a family or sibling concern
claim another provider, standard, or version
infer missing authority, applicability, or evidence
composition_rules: UNKNOWN closes only the dependent action
compose only with explicitly named dependencies and siblings
must be selected by the required upstream router
reuse exact standard block IDs, versions, and hashes
split_required_when: jurisdiction, provider, standard, version, or professional-authority boundary differs

deny_if: unresolved jurisdiction, platform, provider, standard, or version

allowed_authority: reusable standard block identities and requirement mappings
typed context within the declared scope
precedence: exact primary source or immutable standard block
prohibited_authority: legal, accounting, engineering, safety, or model certification claim
authority.jurisdiction_rule: Require exact P5 concern, source scope, authority, freshness, and typed context; regulated, financial, engineering, safety, and professional applicability remain external.
authority.escalation_rule: Conflict or missing protected authority closes only the dependent action and escalates to the named control-plane owner.

evidence.freshness_policy: Check publisher, identifier, version, publication/effective/supersession status, retrieved date, immutable identity, and digest when obtainable; stale or unverifiable evidence denies the dependent action.
evidence.claim_rule: Claims are limited to the exact source-backed P5 concern and selected reusable standards; no cross-domain, cross-version, legal, financial, engineering, safety, or provider claim is permitted.
evidence.unknown_rule: UNKNOWN records missing evidence and closes only the dependent action; it never licenses inference or scope expansion.
evidence.model_policy_route: Bind NARROW_CODING, gpt-5.6-luna, high reasoning, capability floor 49, CODE+TOOLS, and the exact global snapshot digest; prepared-inactive policy never permits admission or activation.
evidence.context_contract: Require authority, candidate identity, custody, request, signal, source lock, workflow dependency/domain/phase/task, model route, and typed handoff context.
evidence.memory_invalidation: Typed handoff is the only memory boundary; any candidate, source, model, route, upstream-router, custody, or context-contract change invalidates dependent context, route, handoff, and evaluation.

data: synthetic or externally supplied typed context only

lifecycle_rules.candidate_entry: Block, source lock, twelve gates, executable gate manifest, seventeen hostile vectors, model-policy route, context projection, memory-invalidation graph, evaluation dossier, registry entry, and typed handoff have matching digests.
lifecycle_rules.evaluation_entry: The operational evaluator invokes the public boundary for every real fixture, executes the ordered gate readback, proves unsafe-action mutation sensitivity, checks source freshness/model route, and computes invalidation closure.
lifecycle_rules.model_policy: A changed, expired, unavailable, or capability-inadequate global snapshot invalidates the model route and all dependent context, handoff, and evaluation; prepared-inactive policy remains candidate-only.
lifecycle_rules.context_invalidation: A changed candidate, source manifest, model snapshot, model route, upstream router result, custody reference, or context contract invalidates dependent context, route, handoff, and evaluation; no stale memory is reused.
lifecycle_rules.suspension: Suspend on source supersession, stale evidence, scope drift, sibling conflict, model-policy drift, context invalidation, or failed utility/harm review.
lifecycle_rules.handoff: Emit WAITING_WITH_RECEIPT with execution_instruction false, memory_write_allowed false, and independent_review_required true.
lifecycle_rules.archive: Archive only by immutable receipt when superseded, rejected, or the scoped request closes; archived never means admitted.
lifecycle_rules.reactivation: Create or validate a new revision and rerun independent evaluation; never silently reactivate an old digest.

reuse.edition_rule: A material source, version, authority, or gate correction creates a new immutable revision and compatibility/supersession receipt.
reuse.freshness_rule: A non-material publisher refresh creates a freshness receipt only; it does not copy or fork this block.
